text: The Nominating Panel - Sign Variance Committee will select candidates to be interviewed for appointment to the Sign Variance Committee. The Nominating Panel will conduct interviews at its next meeting and will recommend two candidates to City Council for appointment.

The Nominating Panel - Sign Variance Committee: 1. Selected the following candidates for interview for appointment to the Sign Variance Committee: Candidate SVC2-103 Candidate SVC2-106 Candidate SVC2-111 Candidate SVC2-115 Candidate SVC2-116 Candidate SVC2-117 Candidate SVC2-118 Candidate SVC2-119 Candidate SVC2-121 2. Directed that Confidential Attachments 1 and 2 to the report (March 3, 2026) from the City Clerk remain confidential in their entirety as they relate to personal matters about identifiable individuals being considered for appointment to the Sign Variance Committee.
